Hi Priya / Sam —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we can get a POC standing up with minimal friction.

Key integration & architecture items we discussed:
- SDK & auth: SDK bootstrap, API key vs. service account auth, short-lived tokens for staging
- Routing & structured output: routing model variants (hosted/dedicated), structured tool-calling for your document ingestion flow
- Embeddings & rerankers: where to compute embeddings (staging vs. private), candidate reranker flow and eval metrics
- Networking / private connectivity: VPC endpoints (PrivateLink), IP allowlist, egress & DNS resolution, optional mTLS for dedicated/private deployments

Action items I propose:
1) Tech deep-dive (60m) with your network + infra leads to confirm VPC endpoint vs. VPN approach
2) Share sample IP ranges / firewall rules from our side and get FinPay firewall requirements
3) Provide SDK sample config and staging API key for a quick integration test

Attachments: redwood-vpc-guide.pdf (recommended network options), network-diagram.png (high-level flow).

Could you share the best contact for your network team? If week of May 2 works for you, we can aim to schedule the deep-dive then.

Thanks —

Hi Priya —

Quick answers and a concise list of what we typically need for a PrivateLink/VPC endpoints integration: 

1) IPs / endpoints
- For hosted API we provide region-scoped VPC endpoints; examples for planning (not final): 34.208.12.0/24, 34.208.13.0/24 (us-west), and 52.27.16.0/24 (us-east).
- For Dedicated we can provide a static egress IP range once capacity is provisioned — we'll supply exact ranges before cutover.

2) mTLS
- mTLS is optional for POC. Recommended for Dedicated/Private deployments in production for mutual auth between your client and our endpoint. If you want, we can enable mTLS in the dedicated staging environment and provide certs for your side.

3) DNS & egress
- We recommend split-horizon DNS so your VPC resolves redwood.private.<region>.internal to the PrivateLink endpoint. If you cannot use PrivateLink, we support NAT egress with IP allowlist and documented DNS overrides.

4) Auth & SDK
- Supported auth: API keys (short-lived tokens via our SDK), OIDC service account exchange, or mTLS client cert for dedicated/private. Attached is a sample SDK config (sdk-config-sample.yaml) showing how to point the SDK to an internal endpoint and swap auth modes.

5) Embeddings / reranker placement
- For highest data control, compute embeddings within your VPC and send vectors to our reranker endpoint over the PrivateLink. Alternatively, you can use our hosted embeddings with contractual data handling controls; for the POC, doing embeddings in your staging VPC is the fastest path.

If you send over Carlos’s contact and your firewall team’s expected maintenance windows, we’ll prepare a short runbook for the deep-dive.

Best,
Jonas
